Shopify Plus Enterprise Solutions

Shopify Plus is where ecommerce businesses go when standard Shopify can no longer contain their ambition. As a specialist Shopify Plus agency offering Shopify Plus development, Shopify Plus consulting and enterprise Shopify solutions, Agentix designs and implements sophisticated Shopify Plus ecosystems — custom checkout flows, advanced automation, multi-store management, B2B storefronts and high-volume transaction architecture — without compromising the performance and usability that made Shopify great. Our Shopify Plus experts serve brands processing $1M+ GMV who need proven enterprise Shopify solutions, Shopify Plus development and Shopify Plus consulting — not a generalist developer learning the platform on your budget.

Why it matters

A store engineered to convert — not just to look good.

If you're an ambitious ecommerce brand, shopify plus enterprise solutions should compound revenue at every visit. Here's what we help you achieve:

  • Lift conversion rate across mobile and desktop.
  • Cut friction from browse to checkout.

What's included

Everything you get with Shopify Plus Enterprise Solutions.

01

Shopify Plus store architecture

Enterprise-grade store architecture designed for high-volume traffic, complex product catalogs, multiple sales channels and global operations — built to handle whatever your growth trajectory demands.

02

Custom checkout extensions

Shopify Functions and Checkout Extensions implementing custom discount logic, delivery methods, payment filtering, upsell flows and validation rules impossible to achieve on standard Shopify.

03

Shopify Flow automation

Complex business automation using Shopify Flow — order routing, inventory management, customer segmentation, fraud triggers and operational workflows that eliminate manual processes at scale.

04

Multi-store & multi-market setup

Multi-storefront architecture for brands operating across markets, regions or customer types — with shared inventory management, market-specific pricing and localized customer experiences.

05

Shopify Plus B2B

Shopify Plus's native B2B features fully implemented — company accounts, customer-specific pricing, net payment terms, multi-location account management and B2B-optimized checkout.

06

Enterprise integrations

ERP, WMS, PIM, OMS and loyalty platform integration at enterprise scale — clean, documented and built to handle the data volumes Plus-level operations generate.

Good to know.

The trigger is typically: transaction volume where Plus fees become cost-effective (around $1M+ GMV), operational complexity requiring custom checkout logic, B2B requirements, multi-market needs, or automation requirements that go beyond standard Shopify's capabilities.

Shopify Plus starts at $2,300/month for most merchants. The development and implementation cost depends on complexity. We'll scope your project accurately in a discovery call.

Yes — upgrading to Plus doesn't require a migration in the traditional sense. It's a plan change. The development work involves implementing Plus-specific features (custom checkout, automation, B2B) on top of your existing store.
